config.name: Covr Enrichment
config.description: Adds the Enrichment card to company records and the Contact check card to contact records. The Enrichment card asks for an enrichment run on a company and shows when it was last enriched and its contacts. The Contact check card lets a rep find an email, find a mobile number or verify an email for one contact. The work happens in Covr's enrichment service, which the app reaches through its own function.
